facets.description: EmbeddableHostsController#update passes a nil lookup result to save_host, causing a 500 instead of a 404 for an unknown id.
EmbeddableHostsController#destroy calls destroy on a nil lookup result, causing a 500 instead of a 404 for an unknown id.
EmbeddableHost before_validation calls sub! on a possibly nil host, raising instead of returning a validation error.
EmbeddableHost.record_for_host compares lower(host) with an input host that is not downcased, rejecting mixed-case referers.
EmbeddableHostsController#save_host raises when params[:embeddable_host] is nil.
